text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp, a
time for
intense training. Смарт Фалкон
looks excited to
get started.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Let's go! Let's go, go, gooo! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oops! ☆ I might've gotten a bit carried
away
there! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
Understandable. The Japan Dirt Derby is right
around the corner.

text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby takes place
around the
time summer camp begins,
which means the race
is nearly upon us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's gonna be so many super fast
racers from
my generation.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That means I've gotta win so
spectacularly that
everyone calls it
Generation Falco! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's how good I have to be if I want
everyone
cheering for me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I think I disappointed some people by
running in
the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure about half of my fans
would rather
see me running on dirt.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to win the Japan Dirt
Derby and
show them that side of me
again!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We entered the Satsuki Sho to please
her fans.
She also wants to win the Japan
Dirt Derby for
the same reason. She's
always thinking of her fans
first and
foremost.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over, I'm counting on
you to
come up with a rigorous training
plan for summer
camp!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Haha, someone sounds dependable! I'm
gonna go
hard too and make sure to win!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Summer camp is off to a blazing start!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
